svg.data-weight-note: 8.815 kg (19.43 lb), with two installed PSUs
svg.data-processor: Intel Atom C3558 2.2 GHz 4-core x86, 2 x 8 GB DDR4 SO-DIMM
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: datasheet: "48 x SFP+ switch ports, supporting 1/10 GbE (DAC, 10GBASE-SR/LR) or 1 GbE (1000BASE-T/SX/LX)". Its Supported Transceivers and Cables list adds 10GBASE-RJ45 and 10G-DAC/AOC cable.
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: datasheet: "6 x 100 GbE QSFP28 switch ports, each supporting 40/100 GbE (DAC, 100GBASE SR4/LR4) or 4 x 10/25 GbE (DAC or fiber breakout cable)". Its Supported Transceivers and Cables list adds 40GBASE-SR4/LR4, 40G-DAC/AOC, 100GBASE-SR4/CWDM4/LR4 and 100G-DAC/AOC.
svg.data-emissions: EN 55032 Class A, EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, AS/NZS Class A, ICES-003 Class A, FCC Class A, VCCI Class A, BSMI Class A, TEC Class A
